name: Taifoon example 1b: check my tenant (with the saved key)

parameters.content:
## 1b · Check my tenant
**For:** anyone who saved a key and wants to see its tenant.

**Set up**
Attach your **Taifoon Relayer API** credential (no key yet: run **1a**) to **Get My Tenant** and execute.

Out: tenant id, how it came (`via`), its keys (prefixes only) and the next step the layer suggests.

**Test it:** execute: **Summary** shows the tenant ID, how it came, the key prefixes and the next step.

**Limits:** needs the credential; without it the call answers 401 with how to get a key.

**Needs the community node** `n8n-nodes-taifoon` (tested with 2.1.0): self-hosted n8n → Settings → Community nodes → Install → `n8n-nodes-taifoon`. https://www.npmjs.com/package/n8n-nodes-taifoon
**Tested:** n8n 2.45.5 with n8n-nodes-taifoon 2.1.0, 2026-11-15: imported from this file into a fresh n8n and run against coord.taifoon.dev.

taifoon.description: Reads the tenant of the key saved in the Taifoon Relayer API credential: who it is, its keys, its next step and its own traffic.
